note: Synthetic. Raw Ledger traffic for one quarter, 7200 underwriter questions in arrival order, with nothing sampled or filtered out of it. Every category and every outcome is a draw from a generator seeded with the value above, so no count here was typed by hand. "outcome" is "ok" for a correct answer, "wrong_but_flagged" for a wrong answer Ledger marked as low confidence, and "missed_breach" for a confidently wrong answer that permits a distribution the amendments forbid. "uniform_sample" is the 200 request ids the team drew uniformly at random from this traffic, from the same seeded generator, and "planned_sample_size" is the size they planned for.
